rentalFactors.title: Day multipliers
rentalFactors.explain: Rental amount = daily price × quantity × day multiplier
rentalFactors.explainDetail: Your company defines the multiplier tables. For days not in the table, the 'extra day multiplier' is added to the previous step for each extra day; the next step's multiplier is never exceeded.
rentalFactors.name: Profile name
rentalFactors.extraDayFactorHint: Added for every day between defined steps and after the last step.
